# Home Office Store Sales Snapshot

The data shows two categories across three months, with **Desks** leading overall and **March** as the strongest month. This is best visualized with one trend chart, one composition chart, and one comparison chart.

# Chart Recommendations and Key Findings

| Chart Type | Best Use | Why It Fits This Data |
|---|---|---|
| Line chart | Month-by-month performance | Shows the revenue trend for Chairs vs Desks across Jan–Mar clearly |
| Clustered column chart | Monthly category comparison | Makes it easy to compare Chairs and Desks side by side for each month |
| Stacked column chart | Total revenue composition | Highlights both total monthly revenue and each category’s share of that total |

## Insights
- **Desks outperform Chairs in every month**: 18,000 vs 12,000 in January; 16,000 vs 14,000 in February; 21,000 vs 13,000 in March.
- **March is the peak month** with total revenue of **34,000**, driven mainly by a strong Desk increase.
- **February is the weakest month** at **30,000 total revenue**, with Desks dipping while Chairs only slightly improve.
- **Chairs are relatively stable** compared with Desks, ranging from **12,000 to 14,000**, while Desks are more volatile but higher-growth.

## Dashboard Layout
- **Top row KPI cards**: Total Revenue, Best Month, Best Category, Month-over-Month Change
- **Main left panel**: Line chart for monthly revenue trends by category
- **Main right panel**: Clustered column chart for month-by-month category comparison
- **Bottom panel**: Stacked column chart for total monthly revenue split by category, plus a short insight box

## Quick Actions
- Action: [Button: Build Dashboard](https://www.google.com/search?q=dashboard+layout+sales+analytics+line+chart+clustered+column+stacked+column)
- Action: [Button: Chart Examples](https://www.google.com/search?q=line+chart+clustered+column+chart+stacked+column+sales+dashboard)

## Sources
- Chart selection guidance: https://www.tableau.com/learn/articles/charts
- Microsoft chart types overview: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/available-chart-types-in-office-2016-9c2f2f8b-8f6d-4b71-8c6a-7c6f2d4f7f0f
- Data visualization best practices: https://www.data-to-viz.com/
